1 · Intro

When to use it.

FERDC is an appointment type you may see for faculty records. Its definition and Oracle setup at Vanderbilt are still being confirmed.

Until they are, use the general Oracle hire rules and confirm FERDC details before you enter anything.

Use this whenYou are asked to hire or set up a record for a FERDC appointment.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Do not guess the FERDC setup from a similar record. Bad data in means bad data out for pay and reporting.
  • Open item: What FERDC stands for and which population it covers.
  • Open item: FERDC worker type, hire reason, assignment status, I-9 and background check requirements, and costing.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Work Relationships (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: How You Convert Pending Workers (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Faculty

FERDC

Use when: You are asked to hire or set up a record for a FERDC appointment. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Confirm what FERDC means and who owns it before you start.
  2. Search the person in Our Workforce > Employment Info first.
  3. Apply the hire reason and checks that match the confirmed setup.
  4. Use a correct position and costing.

Watch-outs

  • Do not guess the FERDC setup from a similar record. Bad data in means bad data out for pay and reporting.
  • Open item: What FERDC stands for and which population it covers.
  • Open item: FERDC worker type, hire reason, assignment status, I-9 and background check requirements, and costing.
